resolutions.researcher_notes: REFS_ADDED, same value as recorded (12 in), sourced from EIA's completed-project database, which ties to the exact same docket (CP98-249) as the govinfo FERC notice already staged on this row and gives the as-built diameter. FLAG FOR ORCHESTRATOR: the underlying Feb. 1998 FERC Notice of Application (govinfo 98-5779) describes the PROPOSED lateral as 10-inch, not 12-inch — a material difference, not a rounding variance. Two readings are possible: (a) the diameter was changed between application and construction (not uncommon over a ~9-month filing-to-service window), or (b) one of the two documents has a transcription/typo. No source was found stating both a filing-stage and a completion-stage diameter in the same document, so this could not be resolved further from the documents opened this pass. Since the authoritative as-built source (EIA) matches the sheet exactly, this is recorded as REFS_ADDED rather than UNRESOLVED, but the 10-in/12-in conflict between the two primary sources on this row is real and worth a validity-leg look if anyone revisits this segment.
